This means we can confidently release the currently available HLA-selected dose to Patient Cedar without leaving Patient Maple without support. To summarize what I can contribute to the release record: the replacement-product plan for Patient Maple is the confirmed compatible dose arriving tomorrow at 16:00, which I will formally request once the decision is made.
